metadata.command_line: /tmp/repo/experiments/eval_rs_uep.py --checkpoint /kaggle/input/datasets/vaishakprasadbhat/rs-uep-jscc-models/seed100/best_val.pth --oracle_ranking_file /kaggle/input/datasets/vaishakprasadbhat/rs-uep-jscc-models/seed100/oracle_ranking.json --data_dir ./data --split test --importance oracle,energy,attention --schemes three_tier_25_50_25,two_tier_50_50,three_tier_25_25_50 --seeds 0,1,2,3,4 --include_no_rs --workers 4 --device cpu --output_dir results/multiseed/seed100 --name test_sweep --wandb --wandb_project rs-uep-jscc --wandb_name kaggle-eval-seed100

evaluation.side_info_rule: 0 B for uniform/no_rs, one byte per channel for sorted methods
evaluation.mask_protocol: one master mask per (batch, seed, rate) shared by all methods; smaller schemes use its first columns

insights: Based on 5 channel seed(s); 10000 images per seed. All gains below are paired per seed against the baseline (same packet losses), so they carry no luck-of-the-draw advantage.
Break-even: the best protected method overtakes `uniform` from about erasure_rate = 0.33.

Low-loss penalty: even the best method is 1.40 dB below `uniform` at erasure_rate = 0.3 (two_tier_50_50@energy). This is the block-length effect of a single large RS block, which tiered coding gives up.
Peak gain: +2.83 dB at erasure_rate = 0.4 by three_tier_25_50_25@oracle (95% CI ±0.04, significant).
Importance sources ranked by their best scheme's mean gain over erasure_rate >= 0.35: oracle +2.15 dB, energy +2.09 dB, attention +0.10 dB.
Share of the reference ranking's gain captured: energy 97%, attention 5%. A share above 100% means that source allocated protection better than the reference.
Worst-case images at erasure_rate = 0.4: 5th-percentile PSNR 18.62 dB (three_tier_25_50_25@oracle) vs 16.30 dB (uniform).
Worst-case images at erasure_rate = 0.5: 5th-percentile PSNR 15.42 dB (three_tier_25_25_50@oracle) vs 15.03 dB (uniform).
Seed sensitivity: std across channel seeds stays below 0.3 dB everywhere.
`uniform` shows its steepest fall (-4.44 dB) between erasure_rate = 0.3 and 0.35 -- its cliff.
